subject: history
concept: Exploring one ancient civilization's daily life, homes, and food in an age-appropriate way
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student examines illustrated scenes of daily life in a chosen ancient civilization
exercise.pictorial: Student matches daily-life items to the civilization they came from
exercise.abstract: Student describes one aspect of daily life in the studied ancient civilization

misconception_flags: confuses features between two different ancient civilizations

interest_binding: civilization or angle generated fresh from student's stated interest profile where possible
